name: Necro Pop
description:
About This Game

STORY

You play as Poppi, a ghost who finds herself facing off against an evil darkness known as The Gloam. The Gloam has spread across the land of Ghostreach and trapped friendly ghosts. Poppi, after discovering an ancient amulet that gives her corporeal form, will use her newly found physical power to beat back the encroaching Gloam forces and free her friends!

GAME PLAY

While traversing the land of Ghostreach in an attempt to beat back The Gloam, Poppi will have access to multiple attacks, magics and maybe even a minion, that will assist you in your quest. Hit enemies with your sword, charge it up, maybe shoot a fireball or even blow bubbles to move around! Oh, and for you pogo fans out there, we got you as Poppi will be able to pogo on enemies. Necro Pop allows you, the player, to have agency in how you want to attack enemies or move around the dungeons and challenges.

VISUAL STYLE

Necro Pop showcases our talented teams pixel art chops as we focused on bringing characters to life in cartoon-like glory! The Neo Geo's power lets us create a wonderful and vibrant world for the player to explore again and again.

Necro Pop was developed for the legendary Neo-Geo MVS Arcade and AES home console platforms.
short_desc: Necro Pop is an all-new action genre platformer we lovingly refer to as Arcadevania. On your adventure, you will discover new abilities, upgrades, secrets. You can free your ghostly friends using multiple combat abilities, magics, and maybe even a minion across multiple re-playable dungeons!
